en: Black-and-white image showing a large baroque water castle on an island, photographed from across a broad lake. The building has four round corner towers with domed roofs, a central church-like projection with a tall spire, and formal tree-lined terraces along the shoreline, with two small pavilion buildings near the water. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image side.
